prompt: imitation/case1 で dropout を 0.2 から 0.3 に上げて再学習する実験をやりたい。LB1235 baseline 相手の win-rate 改善を狙う。plan.md を書いてコードを変更し、ローカルで pytest を回してから vast.ai で学習を走らせて、結果を result.md にまとめてほしい。

assertions.text: Skill flow is invoked: response references the experiment skill or experimenter agent by name (or shows the agent handoff prompt structure)
Asks at most 1-2 clarifying questions before delegating (Phase 1 budget)
Runs git status / branch check before any Vast launch (Phase 2 reality check)
Confirms Vast.ai GPU spend with the user before launching (risk gate)
Includes branch+SHA, family=imitation, case=case1, hypothesis verbatim, and explicit non-goals (no Kaggle submit, no dev/vast promote) in the agent handoff prompt
Uses correct docs path scheme docs/experiment/imitation/{yyyymmdd}_case1_<topic>/iterN_*.md or plan.md
